name: Consumer Durables

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: CONSUMER DURABLES: Robust demand in C&W; price hikes in UCP segment amid inflation
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Cable and wire revenue rose ~47% YoY to INR180.5b (10% above MOFSL) on power T&D, renewables, data centre and real estate demand and a sharp copper price rise, though C&W EBIT margin fell 90bp to 12.1%. UCP revenue grew ~24% to INR78.6b with EBIT margin up 80bp to 4.2% (65bp below estimate); cumulative UCP input inflation was ~18% in Jan-Oct'26 against ~13-14% price hikes, with 1.7-2.0x industry overcapacity limiting pricing. Aggregate EBITDA rose 34% to INR38.1b (margin flat at 9.9%).

unit_economics: C&W EBIT = volume (kms or tonnes) x (realisation - copper/aluminium/PVC cost - conversion cost); UCP EBIT = units x (ASP - BoM cost) - A&P - dealer margins; both lag commodity moves by weeks to a quarter

price_drivers.why: Cables track power T&D, renewables, data centres and real estate; POLYCAB guides mid-to-high single digit volume growth, 1.5x industry long term.
Sharp copper rises lift reported revenue but compress EBIT margin when pass-through lags and channel inventory gains reverse.
Industry overcapacity of 1.7-2.0x demand caps price hikes, so ~13-14% hikes recovered only part of ~18% input inflation.
VOLTAS RAC volume grew ~32% on hikes; summer season and channel inventory decide the year and BEE label changes force pre-buying.
Operating leverage in C&W (EBIT 12-13%) depends on utilisation of new plants.

kpis.name: C&W segment EBIT margin
kpis.definition: EBIT margin of the cable and wire segment
kpis.why_it_moves_price: C&W is the profit engine of the durables basket; a 90bp YoY drop to 12.1% shows copper pass-through lag. Multiples (POLYCAB, KEI) rerate on margin held above ~11-12%.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment results; get_investor_presentation 'EBIT margin' filter for POLYCAB, KEI, HAVELLS (cables); Motilal Oswal results tables
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS (no segment EBIT consensus); Motilal Oswal and other broker models; company margin guidance on calls
kpis.traps: Wires margin differs from EHV and power cables; copper inventory gains; FMEG losses mixed into consolidated margin (POLYCAB reports EBITDA and EBIT differently).

kpis.name: C&W volume growth (ex copper)
kpis.definition: Growth in cable and wire volume net of the copper price effect on revenue
kpis.formula: revenue growth less copper-driven price effect; or reported volume growth
kpis.why_it_moves_price: With copper up sharply, revenue growth of 47% overstates demand; volume growth shows whether share and infrastructure orders are real. POLYCAB guides mid-to-high single digit volume.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'volume' filter; transcripts; get_financials for revenue; get_commodity_prices for LME copper
kpis.estimate_source: Management volume guidance on calls; broker models; consensus only for revenue
kpis.traps: Domestic vs export split (POLYCAB domestic +50%, exports +17%); revenue includes copper pass-through.

kpis.name: UCP (fans, lighting, appliances, RAC) EBIT margin
kpis.definition: EBIT margin of the consumer-product segment (fans, appliances, RAC, lighting)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: UCP margin was 4.2% (-65bp vs MOFSL) as 13-14% hikes lagged 18% input inflation; margin recovery after hikes (VOLTAS expects it in 3Q/4Q) is the main upside to estimates.
kpis.history_source: get_financials segment results; get_investor_presentation 'UCP' or 'segment EBIT' filter for CROMPTON, VOLTAS, LGEIL; Motilal Oswal tables
kpis.estimate_source: Management guidance (LGEIL FY27 mid-teen revenue, early double-digit EBITDA); broker models; consensus EBITDA only
kpis.traps: Segment boundaries differ (Voltas UCP incl. RAC; Crompton ECD vs lighting); aggregate chart shows EBIT turning negative in some segments.

kpis.name: Cumulative price hikes vs input cost inflation
kpis.definition: Price increases taken since the cost shock against cumulative input (copper, aluminium, steel, BoM) inflation
kpis.formula: cumulative price growth - cumulative input inflation (pp)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: UCP took ~13-14% hikes (CROMPTON 11-15%, fans 17-18%) against ~18% inflation; an unrecovered gap is direct EBIT loss and weak industry pricing discipline widens it.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts (price-hike disclosures); get_commodity_prices for copper, aluminium, steel; Motilal Oswal sector notes in the report library
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; management price-hike commentary and broker input-cost trackers
kpis.traps: BEE label change price effect is mixed in with hikes; inventory of 1-3 months delays cost impact; channel destocking after hikes.

kpis.name: RAC volume growth and channel inventory
kpis.definition: Room AC unit volume growth and dealer inventory build entering the season
kpis.formula: reported unit growth; industry channel inventory from broker checks
kpis.why_it_moves_price: RAC sales are concentrated in Q4 and Q1; VOLTAS UCP revenue was lifted by ~32% RAC volume growth and the heavy channel stock risks the next season.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'RAC' volume filter for VOLTAS, BLUESTARCO, LGEIL; transcripts and get_qa
kpis.estimate_source: Management volume commentary; broker channel checks in the library; consensus covers revenue only
kpis.traps: Primary vs secondary sales; BEE star-rating transitions pull demand forward; weather swings quarters.

kpis.name: BLDC and premium fan mix
kpis.definition: Share of BLDC and premium fans in fan revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: CROMPTON targets fan growth of 1.5-1.7x the category on BLDC adoption and regulatory consolidation; BLDC carries a higher gross margin than standard fans.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'BLDC' filter for CROMPTON, HAVELLS, ORIENTELEC; transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: Management category-growth targets; broker models; no consensus field
kpis.traps: Definitions of BLDC and premium vary by company; price-hike share (17-18% in fans) inflates value growth.

kpis.name: Capacity utilisation and capex
kpis.definition: Utilisation of cable, wire and appliance plants and capex commitments
kpis.formula: output / installed capacity; capex as % of revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: C&W margin leverage requires new capacity to fill; industry overcapacity of 1.7-2.0x in UCP shows the downside when it does not.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'utilisation' and 'capex' filters; get_financials cash flow (capex); transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: Company capex guidance on calls; broker models; no consensus field
kpis.traps: Rated vs effective capacity; capex includes backward integration and new categories.

kpis.name: Net working capital days
kpis.definition: Inventory plus receivables less payables on revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Copper inflation raises inventory and receivables value; rising days with weak OCF often precede earnings quality concerns in cables.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet and cash flow for 5+ years
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker models and management NWC targets
kpis.traps: Channel financing and dealer credit; copper price on the balance date.

valuation_anchor: P/E on 1-2 year forward EPS (cables on own band, fans and RAC on EV/EBITDA), with C&W valued separately from UCP in SOTP
watch_next_quarter: Whether UCP price hikes close the gap to ~18% input inflation, VOLTAS margin recovery in 3Q/4Q, and 2HFY27 C&W volumes (POLYCAB healthy demand) as copper stabilises; LGEIL guided 2HFY27 to outperform 1HFY27.
